title: Visiting Blanton and wishing they had known Christian Science
summary: Hinton visited Blanton regularly with Chu Berry and Cozy Cole; Thomas regrets he was too new in Science to help properly.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So consequently, I went to see Blanton every other day. First off, a young 22-year-old man being left in California, and being from Tennessee, and having the accomplishment of being with Duke Ellington's great band at the time, and he, at the height of his career, at 22 years old, contracts tuberculosis, and they've got to leave him in a rest home way the heck out of it some place in California -- it just took all of the stuff, all of the energy out of him.

So I went to see him every other day. And on the night that we played broadcast, Chu Berry and Cozy Cole and myself used to do a little tune and dedicate it to him, and he had a radio by his bed, and he would listen to it -- and when I would go out there we would discuss the changes.

And I would see this continual sinking or dying of him, and it just disturbed me so. And you being my best friend, I knew I didn't have any alternative, other than to pray to God, to say, 'Foots, help me. Please come and go with me in dealing with it.'
You know, I've been so sorry that I hadn't been far enough in Christian Science not to know how to help it.
I should have started you out there earlier.

The first thing I should have done is try to get him to engage a registered practitioner who knew how to do the work properly. And see, I was not experienced enough to know how to do ... I did what little work I knew how, but I wasn't able enough to know the truth.
But I had been going longer than you, and I should have asked you to go with me.

But remember he asked us, 'What must I do?' And I think that will stick with me for the rest of my life, Foots. Because we were reading to him, and he was asking us 'What must we do?' And I shall never forget that, because we did...

I tried all I could, but there wasn't... And I did the same thing when Chu got hurt. But I was so young in Science, I didn't know how to deal with treatment properly. You really don't learn how to give a treatment until you go through class. And I hadn't been through class yet. I was just a young student.
I just wanted to have that as a matter of general record, that you...out of all the people, the only person I could come to on this matter was you.
I said, 'Foots, please come with me.'
Yeah, I was... Because he was so great.
